visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Map Lookup Instead of Comparing Every Pair
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every word is compared with every group's first word using a sorted-letters comparison. Use a LinkedHashMap keyed by the sorted letters, which keeps the groups in first-seen order. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The map finds the right group in one lookup instead of re-sorting and comparing with every existing group. It scales to thousands of words, while the nested loops re-sort the same strings over and over.
